title: Xdrip stops in background - no alerts
body:
Xdrip stops running in the background, happened several times lately (wasn't receiving data for two whole nights). I don't know if my phone (Honor 8, Android 7) shuts it down or Xdrip closes. I attach the events log from last time. 
Please help me with this, because this is now a huge problem for me. I even cleared and reinstalled my phone and installed the latest Xdrip but it still happens. Missed reading alert should go of after 20 minutes, sometimes it does but not always. If I unlock my phone it inmediately goes off.
![Screenshot_20200409-225949](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58670031/78941933-ee5f1000-7ab8-11ea-819e-cfcc8f04d5e5.png)

comments.body: I don't know the "Honor" but had the same problem with a Samsung.  Allowing data usage in the background in the app settings helped me to correct the error
My Setting  in xdrip ,hoping it helps
Thank you for the quick answer, but unfortunately both of these boxes were ticked in my settings, so it won't solve the problem for me :(

@vicked-art Would you please close this issue if it has already been resolved?
If not, have you disabled battery optimization of xDrip by Android?
